commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' 2 - 1 Yaser Asprilla (Girona) scores a cracking goal from long range. The goalkeeper was helpless and could do nothing with that shot.
90+6' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+3' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Juan Cruz (Osasuna) will replace Abel Bretones.
90+3' We are about to witness a substitution. Portu (Girona) is replacing Yangel Herrera.
90+2' The attendance is 20260.
90+1' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
87' Here is a change. Aimar Oroz is going off and Vicente Moreno gives the last tactical orders to Unai Garcia (Osasuna).
87' Substitution. David Lopez leaves the pitch and is replaced by Donny van de Beek (Girona).
86' Kike Barja (Osasuna) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
86' One of the Girona players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
85' Osasuna are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
83' One of the players from Osasuna times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
82' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Girona comes to nothing.
79' 2 - 0 Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) unleashes a ferocious shot from just outside the penalty area and the ball goes into the left side of the goal!
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lucas Torro trots off the pitch and is replaced by Iker Munoz (Osasuna).
78' A substitution has been made. Alejandro Catena goes off and Kike Barja (Osasuna) comes on.
76' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
76' Girona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
69' The referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
69' Referee Pablo Fuertes makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether the goal can stand. Let’s see what happens!
68' Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Cristhian Stuani (Girona) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper.
67' Ivan Martin (Girona) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
61' A substitution has been made. Abel Ruiz is replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
61' Substitution. Ruben Garcia is replaced by Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).
61' Michel prepares a substitution. Oriol Romeu is replaced by Ivan Martin (Girona).
59' One of the Girona players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
57' Abel Ruiz (Girona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
53' Osasuna keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
53' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just wide of the right post.
51' The game has come to an end for Viktor Tsygankov. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Yaser Asprilla (Girona).
48' Girona are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
46' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
46' Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Wonderful movement by Girona. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
44' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
43' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
41' One of the Girona players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
38' 1 - 0 Ante Budimir (Osasuna) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the right post. Excellent finish.
37' None of the Osasuna players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
36' Yangel Herrera (Girona) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

34' Osasuna slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
32' Girona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Girona force their opponents to concede a corner.
28' Girona showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
27' The goal by Girona is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
27' Goal! Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) beats the goalkeeper.
26' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) latched onto a loose pass on the edge of the box and let fly, but Paulo Gazzaniga saw it all the way and made a fine save to deny him.
20' Girona concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
18' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
16' Daley Blind (Girona) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Sergio Herrera stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
14' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Paulo Gazzaniga intercepts the ball.
12' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.

6' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Osasuna are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
5' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
4' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
